biotools.summary: Meta-MolNet is a benchmark platform and suite of algorithms for measuring model generalization and uncertainty quantification in drug discovery. It manages a wide range of molecular datasets and includes a graph attention network-based meta-learning model (Meta-GAT) designed for domain generalization.
